children.content: MPs have spoken of "cruel misinformation" and a "stoking of division" during the lead-up to a parliamentary debate on whether or not to pass into law a ban on gay conversion practices in Tasmania.

items.title: Victim-survivors tell of 'devastating' impact of court delays

children.content: Three victim-survivors of child sexual abuse by the same Hobart teacher had to wait years for the criminal trial to conclude. Now, they face more delays for justice in a civil court.

items.title: Charles Wooley elected Hobart's next lord mayor

items.title: Scrapped Firmus float casts doubt on billions in AI data centre builds

items.title: Child care sector faces further changes after shocking abuse exposed

items.title: North Korean workers sold into Russia then stripped of wages, report finds
